diagnostic_not_a_closure_verdict.meaning: No simple comparison of deposited heating against fusion power is an energy-closure test. The OpenMC neutron heating score includes reaction Q through KERMA and the photon score tracks direct photon deposition. A physical closure must account consistently for material nuclear reaction Q, transported/escaped particle energy, source neutron and separately authored alpha birth energy. This control does not compute that full balance; status remains NOT_EVALUATED.

limitation: Gross and net electric quantities are arithmetic outputs of authored alpha deposition, heating recovery, conversion-efficiency, and auxiliary assumptions. They are not a plant thermal cycle or qualified net electric output. The apparent heating-power difference must not be called excess energy; nuclear reaction Q terms are not separately balanced.
